scope: Independent GRU fast-cell hybrid screen; not an official Super-1 study
architecture_sources: Pinned native slow hierarchy; independently implemented minGRU and diagonal ParaGRU cores
objective: Mean full-vocabulary next-token cross-entropy in nats; no teacher, pretraining or auxiliary loss
initialization: Original outer/slow initializer at each width. Native byte-identical to old baseline. New fast input projections PyTorch Linear weights, zero biases; Para diagonal N(0,1/width), projected per-vector L2<=0.5.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.exclusions: Tied token embedding table and all parameters with ndim<2
optimizer.schedule: Linear warmup then cosine to 10% of peak

ranking: Final update-400 checkpoint CE on 32 final-region held-out windows; lower is better. No best-checkpoint selection.

split_metadata.split_rule: SHA256(text) first 16 hex digits mod 100: 0..89 train, 90..94 validation, 95..99 test; exact duplicate texts removed before split
split_metadata.tokenizer: Byte-level BPE 2048, trained on train documents only; EOS 0 between documents

data.note: Exact-text deduplicated hash split; not a decontaminated benchmark or unseen test set.

comparability: Same ordered train/monitor/final windows, 400 updates, AdamW schedule; all three newly trained
Parameters within 1% of 1M, unequal widths/state/FLOPs; no hyperparameter tuning
Native nn.GRU batches input projection, recurrence is still sequential; all wrappers batch readout
minGRU uses positive candidate g(x), direct-space signed-capable Hillis-Steele scan (no log-space scan needed at length32)
ParaGRU uses dense input projection (one head), diagonal recurrent weights and nonlinear gates; no convolution/extra output projection
Para Newton starts f(0,x), at least3 at most8 iterations, residual<=5e-7 or raise; implicit first-order backward uses reverse affine scan
Para recurrent vectors excluded from weight decay and projected to L2 norm0.5 after each optimizer step
Parallelism limited to within32-token segments by slow-state feedback; no full-sequence/GPU speedup claim
Small one-seed screen cannot establish scaling or long-context retrieval; reused validation is not an untouched test

benchmark.measure: Fresh sequential benchmark after all training workers finish; median forward and forward+backward seconds
benchmark.note: Both new-cell backends batch projections and readout identically; native tokenwise also changes outer batching
